records.finding: Eight sites use a shared soil-health protocol with locally adapted sampling; measurements include carbon, pH, bulk density and earthworms.

prior_art: Organic-mineral mixing and organic-carbon pedotransfer functions are established soil-density models. Cross-country evaluation tests usefulness and failure modes, not causal treatment effects.
